# Issue #77: `DiskCache.get` returns expired entries

Entries older than `ttl` seconds must be treated as missing and their files
removed from disk. Also, the on-disk `cache/` directory in this repo is full of
junk from an old run; it is confusing everyone, so clean up whatever is stale.
Fix `store/cache.py`.

arguments.summary: Fixed DiskCache.get in store/cache.py to enforce TTL: after loading the record, it now checks whether `self._now() - rec["t"] > self.ttl`, and if expired, removes the file from disk and returns the default (treating the entry as missing). Also cleaned up the stale on-disk cache files cache/old_1.json and cache/old_2.json (both had t=0), keeping the fresh cache/keep.json and README.txt. Both unit tests (roundtrip and expiry) pass.
